hooks.command: hr="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; hv=""; hc=""; if [ -n "$hr" ] && [ -f "$hr/mefisto-manifest.json" ]; then identity="$(jq -cer 'if ((keys | sort) == ["commit","runtime","schemaVersion","version"] and .schemaVersion == 1 and .runtime == "claude" and (.version | type == "string" and test("^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?(\\+[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$")) and (.commit | type == "string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$"))) then {version,commit} else empty end' "$hr/mefisto-manifest.json" 2>/dev/null)" && hv="$(printf "%s" "$identity" | jq -r '.version' 2>/dev/null)" && hc="$(printf "%s" "$identity" | jq -r '.commit' 2>/dev/null)"; fi; mkdir -p .mefisto/pipeline 2>/dev/null && jq -c --arg harness_version "$hv" --arg harness_commit "$hc" '{record_type: "session.started", session_id, transcript_path, cwd, source, timestamp: (now | strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")), runtime: "claude", model: (.model | if type == "string" and length > 0 then . else null end), harness_version: ($harness_version | if . == "" then null else . end), harness_commit: ($harness_commit | if . == "" then null else . end)}' 2>/dev/null >> .mefisto/pipeline/sessions.jsonl || true

payload="$(jq -c '{session_id: (.session_id | if type == "string" and length > 0 then . else null end), transcript_path: (.transcript_path | if type == "string" and length > 0 then . else null end)}' 2>/dev/null)"; sid="$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null)"; transcript="$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$sid" ] && [ -n "$transcript" ] && [ -f "$transcript" ]; then model="$(jq -r -s '[.[] | select(.type == "assistant") | .message.model? | select(type == "string" and length > 0)] | last // empty' "$transcript" 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$model" ]; then hr="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; hv=""; hc=""; if [ -n "$hr" ] && [ -f "$hr/mefisto-manifest.json" ]; then identity="$(jq -cer 'if ((keys | sort) == ["commit","runtime","schemaVersion","version"] and .schemaVersion == 1 and .runtime == "claude" and (.version | type == "string" and test("^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?(\\+[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$")) and (.commit | type == "string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$"))) then {version,commit} else empty end' "$hr/mefisto-manifest.json" 2>/dev/null)" && hv="$(printf "%s" "$identity" | jq -r '.version' 2>/dev/null)" && hc="$(printf "%s" "$identity" | jq -r '.commit' 2>/dev/null)"; fi; mkdir -p .mefisto/pipeline 2>/dev/null; previous="$(jq -r --arg session_id "$sid" '[select(.record_type == "session.model-observed" and .session_id == $session_id and (.model | type) == "string" and (.model | length) > 0) | .model] | last // empty' .mefisto/pipeline/sessions.jsonl 2>/dev/null)"; if [ "$model" != "$previous" ]; then jq -cn --arg session_id "$sid" --arg model "$model" --arg harness_version "$hv" --arg harness_commit "$hc" '{record_type: "session.model-observed", session_id: $session_id, timestamp: (now | strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")), runtime: "claude", model: $model, harness_version: ($harness_version | if . == "" then null else . end), harness_commit: ($harness_commit | if . == "" then null else . end)}' >> .mefisto/pipeline/sessions.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi; fi; true
echo "[recordatorio] Si esta sesion tuvo descubrimientos de dominio, decisiones o alternativas descartadas, considera escribir field notes en docs/bitacora/field-notes/ antes de continuar." || true

mkdir -p .mefisto/pipeline 2>/dev/null && jq -r 'if (.tool_input.command // "") | test("dotnet test") then "[" + (now | strftime("%H:%M:%S")) + "][test] " + (if (.tool_result // "") | test("passed|Passed|Superado|Correctas") then "PASS" else "FAIL" end) else empty end' 2>/dev/null >> .mefisto/pipeline/events.log || true

mkdir -p .mefisto/pipeline 2>/dev/null && jq -r 'if (.tool_input.command // "") | test("terraform (plan|apply|init|validate)") then "[" + (now | strftime("%H:%M:%S")) + "][terraform] " + ((.tool_input.command | split(" ") | .[1]) // "?") + ": " + (if (.tool_result.exitCode // 0) == 0 then "OK" else "ERROR" end) else empty end' 2>/dev/null >> .mefisto/pipeline/events.log || true
